fill selects overloads by value and ignores end without a start
fill validates encoding before an empty range without encoding the value
fill defaults null and empty encoding while toString rejects them
numeric offsets distinguish infinity from fractional and NaN offsets
UTF-16 searches reject odd-byte matches and floor reverse offsets
UTF-16 buffer and string needles wrap odd-length haystacks differently
toLocaleString shares the toString function
public Buffer methods remain enumerable for instance mocks
